quests.title: Investigate the Missing Shipment
quests.desc: Orlen's supply wagon out of Greywatch is three days overdue — in twenty years it has never been more than a day behind. He asks you to ride the east road and find out what became of it.
quests.objective: Ride the east road and find Orlen's missing supply wagon.
quests.accepted_note: The traveler has taken on the matter of your missing wagon. You don't know if they can handle whatever's out on that road, but we will see.
quests.pitch: My supply wagon out of Greywatch is three days late. Twenty years I've run this shop and it's never been more than a day behind. Something's wrong on that road. I'd take it as a real kindness — and pay you fairly — if you'd ride east and find out what's become of it.
